tasks.short: Evaluate corrective action after health inspection violations

steps.what: Evaluate whether actions taken adequately correct health inspection violations

tasks.design: Retain corrective-action evaluation with the engineer using {DOCS} and {OPS_SYSTEM}. A completed action record or uploaded photograph does not prove that a hazard has been adequately controlled.
tasks.previous_blocker: Adequacy depends on real conditions and whether the original hazard remains.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing inspection and corrective-action records support evidence review.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish administrative completion from effective control.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the practical effect of corrective action.

evidence.claim: Corrective-action adequacy remains professional judgement; no automatic safety clearance is established.

assumptions: Inspection records and action evidence are inputs to human evaluation, not structured proof of safety.
The engineer's inspection, clarification and assessment remain counted in s1.
No new automation service or added maintenance is proposed.
research_questions: Is evidence retrieval a measurable burden separate from evaluating control effectiveness?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Control-effectiveness assessment retains full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret industrial safety regulations for interested parties

steps.what: Clarify the safety regulations question, jurisdiction, equipment context and applicable dates
Retrieve candidate safety regulations and source passages using the specified search criteria
Interpret safety regulations, verify applicability and explain implications to the requester

tasks.design: Configure native search over a controlled source collection in {DOCS}; retain the original passages and links. The engineer verifies currency, applicability and interpretation before explaining the result through {EMAIL} or discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source retrieval competes with context-specific regulatory explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Controlled document collections can support indexed searches and source links.
tasks.still_hard: Determine applicability, exceptions and the practical meaning of a rule.
tasks.human_edge: Explain a defensible interpretation and recognise when specialist advice is needed.
tasks.altitude: Separate retrieval from accountable regulatory interpretation.

reach.task: Confirm source coverage and difficult applicability questions

evidence.claim: Native indexed retrieval can return source passages; applicability and the proposed time effect remain model knowledge rather than a measured safety-engineering result.

assumptions: In s1 the engineer captures question, jurisdiction, activity, equipment category, relevant date, source identifiers and search terms; its 20 hours includes requester clarification.
The engineer maintains source versions, publication dates and coverage; seven added focal hours cover source updates and retrieval checks.
Missing source coverage or conflicting dates trigger manual source research in s3; retrieval produces candidates, never a compliance verdict.
Use native DOCS search and bookmarks before generative answers or a separate crawler; already indexed retrieval earns no new saving.
research_questions: Does controlled native search reduce retrieval after source maintenance while preserving applicability checks?

incremental.description: Source currency and retrieval quality upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross 20 minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net 13. E1 range 0-7 allows weak source coverage and existing search; interpretation and explanation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review machinery plans against safety requirements

steps.what: Review plans and specifications to determine whether machinery safety requirements have been met

tasks.design: Retain safety design review with the engineer using {DOCS} and {OTHER}, the requirements management system. Requirement links support traceability without establishing that all safety requirements are satisfied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Design safety depends on context, hazard analysis and evidence beyond a checklist.
tasks.enabler_now: Requirements systems can link requirements to verification records.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise missing hazards and evaluate whether evidence is adequate.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge the design and account for incomplete requirements.
tasks.altitude: Own safety review conclusions and evidence gaps.

reach.task: Resolve design hazards and verification evidence

evidence.claim: Relatics supports requirements and verification; the digest lists no AI capability and this does not establish an automatic machinery safety judgement.

assumptions: OTHER denotes the existing requirements management system.
The baseline is substantive review; no already-complete structured hazard model or automated safety verdict is assumed.
Existing requirement traceability remains without new automation or added upkeep.
research_questions: Are repeated numerical or document checks separable and measurable without replacing safety judgement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Safety design review retains full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare product usage and precautionary label instructions

steps.what: Determine product usage limits, hazards and required precautionary instructions from approved technical evidence
Assemble product usage and precautionary label instructions from the selected exact text
Review usage instructions and precautionary label wording for accuracy, coverage and readability

tasks.design: Configure templates in {DOCS} linked to {OTHER}, the controlled product information repository, to assemble exact engineer-selected wording. The engineer reviews the draft contribution; printing, publication and final product release remain outside this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected product details and precaution text are repeatedly placed into instruction layouts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can insert controlled wording without generating new safety advice.
tasks.still_hard: Choose complete precautions and communicate them clearly for the intended user.
tasks.human_edge: Own the technical meaning and completeness of the instruction contribution.
tasks.altitude: Reduce instruction assembly while retaining safety content judgement.

evidence.claim: Exact-text template assembly can reuse selected product instructions; the task-specific design and savings are model knowledge.

assumptions: OTHER denotes the controlled product information repository; use native DOCS templates before a custom drafting service.

In s1 the engineer captures product and revision ID, intended use, limitations, hazard references, exact selected precaution text, language and source versions; its 40 hours includes deciding and checking those fields.
Missing product data or unsupported wording returns to manual preparation and review in s3; no hazard category or approved label text is assumed to appear automatically.
Six added focal hours cover template and controlled-text mapping upkeep; two other-role hours cover documentation-owner source corrections.
The output remains a draft contribution; downstream release and printing receive no time credit.
research_questions: Does exact-text native assembly save preparation time after content selection and safety review?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70; gross 30 minus 6 focal upkeep gives central net 24. E1 range 0-12 allows product variation and existing templates; content selection and review remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce source retrieval and instruction assembly while retaining safety interpretation and adequacy decisions.
reach: Check instruction clarity with technical writers
role.ambitious_version: A safety engineer who retrieves and assembles traceable information with less repetition while retaining responsibility for safety conclusions.
